text:
alice.partnerships: Hey all — want to lock down owners/timeline for the joint integration announcement with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant plus the Lambda hardware pilot. High level: marketplace listings + on-prem connector compatibility + hardware perf validation and a coordinated press/partner GTM. Can we sync on dependencies? :wave:
ben_pm: Thanks — timeline suggestion: internal freeze for docs/code by 04/18, partner sign-off by 04/25, soft launch w/ partners 05/02. Is that realistic?
carla_eng: 04/18 code freeze is tight but doable if we scope the on-prem connector to the v1 feature set (ingest + vector search only). Need two more dev cycles for Windows installer and systemd unit tests.
deepak_infra: On the hardware side, Lambda nodes will require CUDA 12 + cuDNN matching. I need to validate the compiled kernels; current CI uses CUDA 11.7. Will take ~5 days to add CUDA12 matrix and perf runs.
emma_product: Also need the compliance checklist for customers doing on-prem. Can someone own the KMS/HSM integration doc? That's a blocking item for enterprise GTM.
frank_sales: Sales & partner ops want final GTM one-pager and 3x partner-approved logos by 05/01. We'll prep joint webinar but need partner PR copy by 04/27.
anne_ops: Suggest we add a rollback playbook for the marketplace listing (version pinning + auto-fallback) and an on-call rotation for first 72 hours after launch. I can draft the runbook.
carla_eng: Parallel ask — we should run a compatibility matrix across Snowflake connector versions + Databricks runtime 13.x + Qdrant 1.6. I'll attach the test matrix after this thread. Quick example test we ran locally:
```
# smoke test
python -m connector.cli sync --source s3://redwood-samples --dest snowflake://dev/schema
curl -sS http://localhost:7700/collections | jq .
```
carla_eng: Local smoke looks fine but reproducing at scale (100k vectors) shows tail latency spikes on CPU-only nodes. Need to validate batching config for on-prem.
deepak_infra: I'll queue the CUDA12 runners and run perf with batch sizes [1,8,32] and KV cache warmup. ETA 4/22.
emma_product: Ownership recap: Alice — partner logistics and PR approvals; Ben — timeline owner; Carla — connector compatibility & tests; Deepak — hardware perf; Anne — runbook; Frank — GTM assets. Confirm?
alice.partnerships: Confirmed. I'll coordinate partner review sessions next week and lock PR copy by 04/27. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CI pipeline (integration-tests) triggered by carla_eng — matrix cuda12 / runtime13 — queued (job id: 2319).
carla_eng: Noted, will monitor. I'll post the test matrix and a short checklist (config knobs, quantization profile, expected latencies) before EOD tomorrow.
frank_sales: Can we also get one perf slide comparing Lambda vs cloud-hosted latency/cost? That helps partner briefing.
deepak_infra: Yes, will include perf/cost delta in the run results.
emma_product: Good — once we have partner sign-off I'll open the marketplace listing draft for legal review.
alice.partnerships: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) Carla update test matrix by EOD, 2) Deepak schedule perf runs by 4/22, 3) Ben to publish timeline doc. We'll meet Tue 10am PT for partner dry-run. :calendar:
frank_sales: +1 for Tue 10am.
anne_ops: I'll slot a pager rotation for the launch week and share on-call calendar.
carla_eng: Uploaded initial matrix to the partners drive: https://redwood.app/drive/partners/connector-compat-matrix (ping me if access issues).
alice.partnerships: perfect — closing thread, will create the calendar invite. :rocket:
